# **✍️ Quick notes**  

## **\#team-one: Uber Presentation Discussion**

  

Aug 31, 2026

[Paloma Calderon](mailto:paloma.calderon@draiver.com) [Dan Rizzo](mailto:dan.rizzo@driverdo.com) [Kevin Burke](mailto:kevin.burke@driverdo.com) [Fede Ranero](mailto:fede.ranero@driverdo.com) [Armando Flores](mailto:armando.flores@driverdo.com) [Bruno Silva](mailto:bruno.silva@driverdo.com) [Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade](mailto:rafael.andrade@driverdo.com) [Paulo Ferrato](mailto:paulo.ferrato@driverdo.com)

  

The project proposal involves operational logistics and technical differentiation to secure the strategic partnership with Uber.

  

## **Houston Pilot Operational Requirements**

  - Plan for 63 W2 employees working in 8-hour shifts.
  - Target initial fleet size of approximately 260 vehicles requiring 13 seats.
  - Set April launch date following heavy hiring and training in Q1.
  - Require facility within 10 minutes of ODS, fitting 5 support vehicles and 2 tow trucks.

  

## **Strategic Positioning**

  - Fede emphasizes the relationship as a long-term partnership rather than a one-time hire.
  - Position the company as a tech-first partner, distinct from traditional staffing firms.
  - Focus on "4 machines": operator acquisition, vetting, training, and operational data visibility.
  - Acknowledge Uber's requirement for W2 employees to mitigate potential misclassification risks.

  

## **Operational Scalability and Modeling**

  - Propose hybrid W2 and independent contractor models to allow for future scaling flexibility.
  - Use historical trip data to optimize operational hub placement and staff distribution.
  - Demonstrate system responsiveness using heat maps and synthetic demand modeling.

  

## **Presentation Strategy**

  - Prepare for the Tuesday, 8th meeting with a concise, high-impact visionary deck.
  - Use video demonstrations to showcase operational tech while protecting sensitive client identities.
  - Structure the pitch with extensive appendices to address potential technical follow-up questions.

  

## **Proposal Strategy and Competitive Positioning**

  - Fede Ranero emphasizes the necessity of developing distinct, high-quality content to avoid submitting generic, "copy-paste" proposals.
  - The team estimates the probability of winning the bid at approximately 50%, an increase from the initial 20-30% projection.
  - Fede Ranero directs the team to prioritize this project, requesting deep individual focus and significant time investment to enhance the proposal's competitive edge.

  

## **Project Management and Cadence**

  - Fede Ranero suggested implementing daily sync meetings to track progress on presentation materials and refine the overarching strategy.

  

## **Next steps**

  - \[Fede Ranero\] Share intelligence: Send the competitor intelligence document and related podcast to the team.
  - \[The group\] Compile appendix: Create a list of case studies and story lines to be ready by Friday. This content will serve as an appendix for the final proposal.
  - \[The group\] Rehearse pitch: Conduct practice sessions on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday. Ensure the full presentation deck is rehearsed for the meeting on Tuesday.
  - \[Bruno Silva\] Design deck: Enhance the visual design of the slides using the driver design system. Ensure the presentation is aesthetically professional.
  - \[Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade\] Identify supervisors: Review the current team for qualified W2 staff who could serve as site supervisors in Houston.
  - \[Fede Ranero\] Define agenda: Develop the structure for the pitch meeting agenda.
  - \[The group\] Create playbook: Develop a slide showing the playbook for scaling operations in the United States and abroad.
  - \[The group\] Develop Proposal: Develop presentation slides detailing both long term and express launch models. Include all relevant technical capabilities and operational strategies.
  - \[Bruno Silva\] Create Video Mockup: Create a brief animation demonstrating artificial intelligence driven trip creation and heat map visualizations. Use this visual aid to illustrate system responsiveness without displaying real customer names.
  - \[Paloma Calderon\] Plan Houston Hubs: Propose specific locations for operational sites in Houston based on historical data and travel volume patterns. Tailor the distribution to ensure optimal coverage for anticipated routes.
  - \[The group\] Schedule Daily Sync: Conduct daily meetings to review progress on presentation materials and refine the proposal strategy. Align all members on the core message and document formatting.

## **\#team-one: Uber Presentation Discussion**

Invited [Paloma Calderon](mailto:paloma.calderon@draiver.com) [Dan Rizzo](mailto:dan.rizzo@driverdo.com) [Kevin Burke](mailto:kevin.burke@driverdo.com) [Fede Ranero](mailto:fede.ranero@driverdo.com) [Armando Flores](mailto:armando.flores@driverdo.com) [Bruno Silva](mailto:bruno.silva@driverdo.com) [Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade](mailto:rafael.andrade@driverdo.com) [Paulo Ferrato](mailto:paulo.ferrato@driverdo.com)

Attachments [\#team-one: Uber Presentation Discussion](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?eid=bDJwcGFlNXVhNXIyMmtsZ2p0YzhlcTlyY28gZmVkZS5yYW5lcm9AZHJpdmVyZG8uY29t)

### **Summary**

The project proposal involves operational logistics and technical differentiation to secure the strategic partnership with Uber.  
  
**Operational and Facility Planning**  
The project requires hiring 63 W2 staff members to support a fleet of 5 vehicles and 2 tow trucks. Teams must secure a facility near deployment sites by the first quarter to enable an April launch.  
  
**Strategic Positioning and Competition**  
The team aims to distinguish itself from standard staffing agencies by leveraging data-driven optimization and four core operational machines. They will utilize technology to demonstrate marketplace control while avoiding direct comparisons to competitors.  
  
**Presentation and Preparation Strategy**  
The team finalized an interactive presentation plan combining slide decks with live visual demonstrations to highlight technical prowess. All members must prioritize this proposal above other tasks to maximize win probability.

  
  

### **Decisions**

## **Aligned**

  - **Presentation submission deadline** The final draft of the presentation appendix is set for completion by end of day Friday, with Saturday reserved for a full deck rehearsal if required.
  - **Presentation delivery format** The presentation strategy for the Uber pitch is set to use live narration with silent video clips rather than pre-recorded audio to ensure client confidentiality and maintain interactive engagement.

  
  

### **Next steps**

  - \[Fede Ranero\] Share intelligence: Send the competitor intelligence document and related podcast to the team.
  - \[The group\] Compile appendix: Create a list of case studies and story lines to be ready by Friday. This content will serve as an appendix for the final proposal.
  - \[The group\] Rehearse pitch: Conduct practice sessions on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday. Ensure the full presentation deck is rehearsed for the meeting on Tuesday.
  - \[Bruno Silva\] Design deck: Enhance the visual design of the slides using the driver design system. Ensure the presentation is aesthetically professional.
  - \[Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade\] Identify supervisors: Review the current team for qualified W2 staff who could serve as site supervisors in Houston.
  - \[Fede Ranero\] Define agenda: Develop the structure for the pitch meeting agenda.
  - \[The group\] Create playbook: Develop a slide showing the playbook for scaling operations in the United States and abroad.
  - \[The group\] Develop Proposal: Develop presentation slides detailing both long term and express launch models. Include all relevant technical capabilities and operational strategies.
  - \[Bruno Silva\] Create Video Mockup: Create a brief animation demonstrating artificial intelligence driven trip creation and heat map visualizations. Use this visual aid to illustrate system responsiveness without displaying real customer names.
  - \[Paloma Calderon\] Plan Houston Hubs: Propose specific locations for operational sites in Houston based on historical data and travel volume patterns. Tailor the distribution to ensure optimal coverage for anticipated routes.
  - \[The group\] Schedule Daily Sync: Conduct daily meetings to review progress on presentation materials and refine the proposal strategy. Align all members on the core message and document formatting.

  
  

### **Details**

  - **Proposed Operational Scope and Hiring**: Dan Rizzo detailed the requirements for the proposed project, which involves maintaining five support cars staffed with two people each to ensure a response time within 10 minutes of an incident flagging. The operation requires a minimum of one tow truck and necessitates hiring approximately 63 staff members to work eight-hour shifts, alongside an HR representative and a program manager. These individuals must be W2 employees, as the client has expressed no interest in an independent contractor model at this time.
  - **Operational Timeline and Facility Requirements**: Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade and Paulo Ferrato outlined the schedule, which includes heavy hiring in January and February, intensive training throughout February and March, and a go-live date in April ([00:01:10](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.u5fyslxkecbv)). The team must secure a facility located within 10 minutes of the client's operation deployment sites to house the five support vehicles, two tow trucks, and a small office space. Paulo Ferrato confirmed that while properties have been scouted and brokers contacted, a lease agreement must be finalized to ensure the location is adapted and ready by the end of the first quarter ([00:02:15](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.6odbsfwkozu4)).
  - **Financial Context and Fleet Scale**: Fede Ranero noted the company is projected to close the year at 45 million in revenue. The initial contract for managing the fleet in Houston involves approximately 200 vehicles, based on a ratio of 1 seat per 20 vehicles for the 13 initial seats, although this remains an estimate ([00:03:36](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.2r2g8eluomw)).
  - **Vehicle Technology and Client Strategy**: Fede Ranero explained that the fleet consists of Lucid Gravity vehicles equipped with Nuro self-driving systems, which have received equity backing from Uber. Uber is positioning itself as the demand channel and aggregator, aiming to increase vehicle utility and trip frequency, with a goal of utilizing its substantial equity investments in the space ([00:04:45](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.a4k44brl4kvu)). The team aims to earn "trusted partner" status by focusing on vehicle uptime and utilization at the highest point of the demand curve, planting the seed for future scalability into tens of thousands of vehicles across multiple cities ([00:05:54](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.eyongk647c3l)).
  - **Strategic Positioning**: Fede Ranero emphasized that this contract serves as an entry point, or "Hawaii," for the company, requiring flexibility and understanding of the client's current needs while demonstrating the capability to scale. The company aims to differentiate itself from traditional staffing firms or employers of record by showing advanced operational capabilities, even if the current scope involves fixed W2 roles and specific facilities ([00:07:01](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.e97g0y9kn1ge)).
  - **Competitive Landscape**: Fede Ranero identified competitors such as Taskos and advised the group to avoid being categorized as a standard staffing agency ([00:08:16](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.c4mgada7d41r)). The team will focus on showcasing their "four machines"—operator acquisition, vetting and training, captive insurance, and data-driven optimization—to prove they can handle high-complexity operations ([00:09:27](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.ku1d9ayu4bsk)) ([00:17:12](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.pe7b78yfb988)). Fede Ranero planned to share a competitor intelligence document and a podcast to provide context on the opposition ([00:08:16](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.c4mgada7d41r)).
  - **Presentation and Meeting Strategy**: Fede Ranero and the team discussed the upcoming meeting on Tuesday the 8th, agreeing that the presentation should be a combination of a slide deck and live demonstrations ([00:10:48](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.rtxfrqll05az)) ([00:22:22](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.wser6sew6dm9)). The team aims to avoid over-presenting and will focus on an interactive, simplified narrative of the proposal, using their existing 98-slide submission as a base while keeping specific details in an appendix ([00:11:57](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.ha66lvt0snkp)) ([00:29:52](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.8estm32pzcm9)). They will utilize existing case studies from companies like Kavak and Pensky, using video demonstrations to protect client confidentiality ([00:11:57](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.ha66lvt0snkp)) ([00:25:33](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.ilq4ka9y6rwc)).
  - **Internal Preparation and Workflow**: The team agreed to prioritize this proposal above all other routines, setting a goal to have a solid final draft of a long appendix by Friday end-of-day. Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade proposed holding a rehearsal on Saturday to ensure the team is fully prepared for the Monday/Tuesday meetings ([00:23:16](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.m482at5l2gk4)) ([00:33:30](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.42tlqpc11rxn)). Fede Ranero encouraged the team to focus on the strategic vision and creative elements of the deck rather than just the layout ([00:34:17](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.7824b1cqgtqn)).
  - **Addressing Legal and Operational Concerns**: Bruno Silva and Rafael Pagliuso De Andrade discussed the importance of the W2 requirement, noting that Uber is focused on avoiding misclassification lawsuits ([00:52:58](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.iuoj4a395q87)). While Uber currently requires W2 employees, the team intends to frame their pitch to highlight the flexibility of their technology, ensuring that if the client moves toward a hybrid or contractor model in the future, the company is prepared to support that transition ([00:14:18](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.ve9oxhnjdz8e)) ([00:51:04](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.d272j8e031y8)).

  - **Leveraging Technology and Data**: The team explored ways to showcase their technical prowess, including using heat maps to demonstrate demand anticipation and dispatch optimization ([00:47:02](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.4zgsiu6cqwhy)). Paloma Calderon suggested that displaying their control over the marketplace and ability to use data for positioning employees or resources would be a key differentiator ([00:49:09](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.aym5j0b7jfdy)). Fede Ranero reinforced that all discussions, whether regarding insurance or operations, should be anchored in technology and the "four machines" framework ([00:17:12](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.pe7b78yfb988)) ([00:21:32](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.tcdvdg891war)).

  - **Refining Competitor Cohorts**: Paulo Ferrato and Fede Ranero discussed categorizing competitors into three cohorts—fleet management, offline local players, and new market commerce firms—to better highlight the company’s unique blend of technology and operational scale ([00:43:46](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.cty7lybihpb9)). This approach will allow the team to tailor their differentiators depending on which type of competitor they are compared against ([00:44:48](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.erkir8u1pc33)).
  - **Final Meeting Preparation**: Fede Ranero directed the team to focus their upcoming efforts on refining the slide deck, integrating visual demonstrations of their technical capabilities, and preparing to pivot quickly into a question-and-answer format during the meeting with Uber. The team will create short video clips for demonstrations, ensuring they are presented live without audio to maintain professionalism while avoiding the disclosure of sensitive customer names ([00:56:15](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.t8efguckvjxc)).
  - **Project Presentation and Personal Commitment**: Fede Ranero discusses the preparation of presentation materials, emphasizing the importance of the current project and sharing that they have been dedicating significant time and thought to it, even amidst personal distractions. Fede Ranero expresses a clear expectation that all team members must invest the same high level of energy to ensure the project is successful ([00:58:00](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.4rcx5i9jriaj)).
  - **Winning Probability and Strategic Differentiation**: Fede Ranero assesses the team's chance of winning, stating that while they initially estimated the probability at 20-30%, they believe it has increased, though they acknowledge it may still be a "coin flip". To improve their chances, Fede Ranero urges the team to go above and beyond to provide distinct thinking, specifically warning against simply copying and pasting the proposal sent to Task Cost, as that would be an ineffective approach ([00:58:00](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.4rcx5i9jriaj)).
  - **Execution Strategy and Follow-up**: Fede Ranero instructs the team to clear their agendas and engage in deep work, suggesting that they should spend tokens on personal plans if necessary to prioritize this effort. To maintain momentum, Fede Ranero proposes a daily meeting cadence to track progress, with the team planning to reconnect the following day to determine the next steps ([00:58:00](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.4rcx5i9jriaj)).
  - **Meeting Conclusion**: The meeting concludes with Paloma Calderon, Fede Ranero, Paulo Ferrato, Armando Flores, and Bruno Silva exchanging closing pleasantries and confirming their shared excitement regarding the project ([00:58:00](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12aR4saTw4PDLdd3wVlLjkL22aPZTbRs6dlmV6ZgdQA0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.4rcx5i9jriaj)).
